map.气象风向指风的来向：225° 表示西南风（从西南吹来）。: Meteorological wind direction means the direction the wind comes from: 225° means a southwest wind (blowing from the southwest).
map.由方位角（度）转 16 方位（N/NNE/NE…）。: Convert the bearing (degrees) to a 16-point direction (N/NNE/NE...).
map.风向标读数与报文互转。: Convert between wind vane readings and reports.
map.污染扩散按风向定受体。: Determine the receptor for pollution dispersion by wind direction.
map.90°→东(E)、225°→西南(SW)、0°/360°→北(N)、315°→西: 90°→east (E), 225°→southwest (SW), 0°/360°→north (N), 315°→northwest (NW); one step every 22.5°, 16 points in total.
map.「北风」指从北吹来（去向南），污染源在北侧时下风向（南）受体浓度高，布点看去向。: A "north wind" blows from the north (toward the south); when the pollution source is to the north, the downwind (south) receptors have high concentrations, so siting looks at the direction of travel.
map.风向是来向还是去向？: Is wind direction the source or the destination?
map.气象风向指「来向」（北风从北来）；但风羽箭头常画去向，读图注意区分。: Meteorological wind direction is the source direction (a north wind comes from the north); but wind barbs often draw the direction of travel, so distinguish carefully when reading charts.
map.日常足够，精细扩散用 0–360° 连续角，方位仅作播报简化。: Enough for daily use; fine dispersion uses a continuous 0-360° angle, and bearings are just a broadcast simplification.
